jobs_results.title: Data Engineer (80% Teletrabajo)
jobs_results.description:
¿Te interesaría seguir desarrollándote como Ingeniero/a de Data en una empresa líder del sector transportes y turismo en un entorno colaborativo con jerarquía horizontal y con proyección a futuro, ubicada en el Baix Llobregat?

Desde Oxigent Technologies seleccionamos un/a DATA ENGINEER para formar parte de un equipo de profesionales cuya misión será la extracción y transformación de datos para almacenarlos en un Data Lake y posteriormente ser analizados en base a los requerimientos del negocio.

Para ello, ¿qué vas a necesitar?
• Al menos 3 años de experiencia como Data Engineer.
• Programación Python y SQL.
• Experiencia en AWS
• CI/CD (Git, Jenkins, SonarQube, Terraform, Azure DevOps…)
• Orquestación: Airflow, Kubernetes (EKS)

¿Qué te ofrecemos?
• Contratación indefinida a través de Oxigent.
• Salario acorde a la experiencia aportada (entre 43.000 - 55.000 euros brutos anuales).
• Horario flexible y jornada intensiva los viernes y los meses de verano.
• Modelo híbrido (4 días... remoto – 1 día oficina)
• Cheque Formación para desarrollarte en las áreas profesionales que más te interesen.
• Seguro médico privado.
• Retribución flexible aplicable a seguro médico, restaurante, transporte, guardería y formación.
• Aplicación de acceso a gimnasios y actividades deportivas en toda España con descuentos.

¡Y muchos otros beneficios

jobs_results.title: Azure Data Engineer
jobs_results.description:
As a Senior Azure Data Engineer, you will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and maintaining robust data architecture and pipelines within our organization's Azure environment. Your primary responsibility will be to ensure efficient and effective data collection, storage, processing, and analysis, leveraging Azure's suite of data services. This role demands a deep understanding of Azure data technologies and a commitment to excellence in data engineering practices.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
• Design and implement data architecture: Develop comprehensive data architecture solutions encompassing storage, processing systems, and analysis tools using Azure services such as Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Databricks, and Azure SQL Database.
• Develop and maintain data pipelines: Build and manage data pipelines for extracting, transforming, and loading data from diverse sources into our Azure-based data architecture. Utilize Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, and... Azure Stream Analytics to ensure seamless data flow.
• Implement data security and privacy: Ensure compliance with data security and privacy regulations by implementing robust security features provided by Azure, including Azure Active Directory and Azure Key Vault.
• Monitor and troubleshoot data systems: Continuously monitor data architecture and pipelines to identify and resolve issues promptly, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams: Work closely with data scientists, business analysts, software engineers, and external partners to align data solutions with organizational objectives and requirements.

Minimum Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar role within a large private-sector IT organization.
• Preferred certification: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) or higher.
• Proficiency in agile or scrum methodologies preferred.
• High level of proficiency in English language.

Skills and Competencies:
• Expertise in Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake, and Azure App Service.
• Proficient in SQL databases and programming languages.
• Familiarity with Microsoft BI Stack: SSRS/SSAS, Tabular with DAX & OLAP with MDX, SSIS.
• Experience with Azure DevOps for automating data pipeline deployment, testing, and monitoring.
• Knowledge of Power BI is desirable.
• Ability to guide the development of data requirements and drive user-centric experiences.
• Strong project management skills, including the ability to lead cross-functional teams and deliver projects on time and within budget.
• Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
• Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

Conditions:
• Competitive Salary
• Hybrid Model
• Trainings
• 2,000€ on Benefits

jobs_results.title: Data Engineer Spark y Scala MADRID
jobs_results.description:
En The Whiteam Consulting estamos buscando Data Engineer con inglés y al menos 2-3 años de experiencia para formar parte de un importante proyecto de empresa multinacional, estable a largo plazo , en Madrid 🚀

¿Qué buscamos? 🔍

Necesitamos que domines:

✔️ Spark y Scala

✔️ Inglés B2. Escrito y oral fluido.

Se valorará otros conocimientos técnicos como: HDFS, Parquet, IBM Cloud Object Storage, MongoDB, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Ksh, Autosys, Oozie, Airflow, Dremio, Dataiku, migración SAS a Python valorable.

¿Cómo trabajarás? 💼

Modalidad híbrida, Madrid, 75% de teletrabajo 💻 📌

Rango salarial 30.000€ B.A. - 40.000€ B.A., según perfil/experiencia.

Compañía 📈

Formar parte de THEWHITEAM es colaborar con una empresa formada por profesionales con una dilatada experiencia en consultoría tecnológica.

Creemos firmemente que las empresas y clientes marcan el camino a seguir en el sector, pero éste lo construyen las personas. Consideramos de vital importancia que nuestra organización se... fundamente en nuestro mejor activo y marca de valor añadido que es nuestro equipo humano.

Beneficios ✅

Por otra parte, el resumen de políticas de la compañía para que nos vayas conociendo un poco mejor:

⭐ Nuestro convenio es el de Consultoras y estudios de mercado.

⭐ Tenemos 23 días de vacaciones al año.

⭐ La empresa da como regalo el día de nuestro cumpleaños, para que podamos disfrutar de él sin trabajar.

⭐ Tenemos 14 pagas, 12 mensuales y dos extras (junio y diciembre).

⭐ Como retribución flexible podemos pedir ticket guardería y también seguro médico + dental.

Si estás buscando una nueva oportunidad laboral y crees que tu perfil puede encajar, ¡no dudes en apuntarte! 🏆

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero de Sistemas PLM
jobs_results.description:
En Exportadora Data Base, contamos con más de 20 años de experiencia en servicios de Consultoría IT. Trabajamos siempre a la vanguardia en el campo de la innovación y la tecnología, tanto en la ingeniería de Software como en la consultoría tecnológica.

Nos encontramos en búsqueda de un Ingeniero de Sistemas PLM con 3 o más años de experiencia para cliente líder del Sector Tecnológico.

Requisitos:
• Sólida experiencia en la implantación y gestión de sistemas PLM a gran escala en una organización empresarial.
• Sólidos conocimientos de los procesos de desarrollo de productos y las operaciones de fabricación.
• Experiencia en software PLM como Siemens Teamcenter, PTC Windchill, Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE o SAP PLM.
• Experiencia demostrada en integración de sistemas, incluidas herramientas ERP, MRP y CAD.
• Excelentes aptitudes para la gestión de proyectos, con experiencia en la dirección de equipos de proyecto interfuncionales.
• Gran capacidad analítica y de resolución de... problemas.

Funciones:
• Dirigir la planificación, el diseño y la implantación de sistemas PLM en toda la organización y con el editor e integrador seleccionados para satisfacer las necesidades empresariales.
• Elaborar y ejecutar el plan de transición del sistema PLM de Renault (RVT - Renaulution Virtual Twin, una implementación en la nube de Dassault Systèmes adaptada a las necesidades de Renault) al sistema PLM de Horse.
• Llevar a cabo un análisis exhaustivo de los requisitos para recopilar los requisitos empresariales y funcionales de todos los departamentos.
• Desarrollar y mantener la documentación del proyecto, incluyendo la arquitectura del sistema, las especificaciones de diseño y los planes de implementación.
• Configurar y personalizar el software y las herramientas PLM para adaptarlos a las necesidades específicas de la organización.
• Supervisar la integración de los sistemas PLM con otros sistemas de la empresa como ERP, MRP, CAD y herramientas CAE para garantizar un flujo de datos y procesos sin fisuras.
• Dirigir la fase de pruebas, incluidas las pruebas del sistema, de integración y de aceptación del usuario, para garantizar que la solución cumple todos los requisitos.
• Facilitar sesiones de formación para usuarios finales y crear guías de usuario y materiales de formación detallados.
• Proporcionar asistencia y mantenimiento continuos para los sistemas PLM, incluida la resolución de problemas y la optimización del rendimiento.
• Mantenerse al día de las últimas tendencias y tecnologías en sistemas PLM para recomendar mejoras y ampliaciones.
• Actuar como experto en la materia de los sistemas PLM, proporcionando orientación y liderazgo al personal subalterno.

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Proyecto estable (indefinido).
• Modalidad híbrida (3 días teletrabajo, 2 presenciales) con residencia en Madrid.

Si crees que puedes encajar en la oferta, no dudes en inscribirte

jobs_results.description: SQL, Implementierung, Business Intelligence, Softwareentwicklung, Relationale Datenbanken, ETL, Batch Processing, Softwarearchitektur, Informatik, Data Engineering, Webservices, Cloud Computing, Agile Methoden, Datenbanken, Java Business Intelligence - Data Engineer (f/m/d) Business Intelligence - Data Engineer (f/m/d) Full-time, from 01.04.2024 in Coburg, open-ended In addition to a great team of more than 10,000 friendly colleagues and over 770 different job profiles, we offer experienced professionals and newcomers many attractive challenges that modern insurance companies face: Will the car of the future cause fewer accidents? What will retirement provision look like when everyone reaches the age of 100? We deal with the questions of tomorrow - for needs-based insurance for our more than 12 million customers - at our headquarters in Coburg in Upper Franconia and at our 38 branch offices in the office and in the field. What you can look forward to Design and development of... integrated BI solutions, from requirements gathering to data modeling and ETL Define the requirements for the data supply routes (real-time or batch) together with the specialist departments Technical responsibility for ensuring the timely data management of BI solutions Continuous improvement of the BI development process and application of appropriate process models (e.g. agile methods) Teamwork in a motivated team and cooperation with many departments in various projects What you bring with you Degree in (business) informatics, mathematics, physics or a comparable course of study Alternatively, completed training as an IT specialist with professional experience Programming skills in Java (web services), SQL, experience with relational databases Practical experience in the implementation and design of BI solutions Knowledge of tools (e.g. Datastage, Talend) and development methods in the BI environment Knowledge of software architectures and software development in the cloud environment (public, on-prem) Strong communication skills as well as persuasiveness and assertiveness What we offer you Flexible working: For us, flexible working means that you can adapt your working hours to suit your circumstances. There are no core or minimum working hours with us. Instead, you perform your workload within a defined working time frame - adapted to local requirements if necessary. Thanks to mobile working, you can even work up to half of your monthly working hours from home or on the road under certain conditions. Family-friendly working: We attach great importance to achieving an optimal work-life balance. For us, this includes support with childcare, vacation care and caring for relatives, as well as the opportunity to take on a part-time management position. We have been recognized as a family-friendly employer by the berufundfamilie audit since 2007. Results-oriented remuneration: In addition to your twelve monthly salaries, you will receive two collectively agreed special payments each year. And to make performance worthwhile, you will participate in a performance and results-oriented remuneration scheme, with the opportunity to receive more than one additional monthly salary. Your many years of loyalty to the company will also pay off: you will receive an anniversary payment, staggered according to your length of service. Lifelong learning: If you are working on the future, you must not stand still in the past. To ensure that you are always up to date, we support your professional development measures - both internally and externally. However, the focus of our training measures is not only on acquiring company or job-specific qualifications, but also on the private promotion of individually desired skills - e.g. language courses, driver safety training and much more. Healthy working: Keep fit and healthy. We support you with free sports activities in our company sports facilities or a subsidy for your gym membership. Particularly active employees can take part in various HUK sports groups in their free time: e.g. running, biking or team sports such as soccer or basketball. Or learn how to integrate a healthy lifestyle into your everyday life, both professionally and privately, in lectures and seminars. And because health is also about nutrition, you can enjoy healthy and handmade delicacies in our coffee bars or the company restaurant. Have we piqued your interest? Then apply now! If you have any questions, please contact Ms. Julia Winter at the telephone number +49 9561 96-13283,

jobs_results.title: Data Engineer
jobs_results.description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

What We'll Bring

TransUnion is a major credit reference agency, and we offer specialist services in fraud, identity and risk management, automated decisioning and demographics.

We support organisations across a variety of sectors including finance, retail, telecommunications, utilities, gaming, government and insurance.

What You'll Bring

Data Engineering & Analytics practice enables Data Analytics driven culture across the organization. It’s a fast-growing practice which has functions like Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Data Visualization, Data COE & ML Engineering. This team works across all phases of data lifecycle.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Data Engineer to join our growing Data Engineering and Analytics Practice. You will be based in our offices in Madrid and working part-time remotely as part of our ‘flex together’ approach. We are in a cloud transformation process, and we need you! This exciting role will offer a... host of development opportunities as part of a growing global business.

Day To Day You’ll Be
• Passion for technology in the field of data engineering and analytics
• Design, build, test and deploy cutting edge big data solutions at scale
• Extract, clean, transform, and analyze vast amounts of raw data from various Data Sources
• Build data pipelines and API integrations with various internal systems
• Improving and maintaining our data ware house.
• Experience on data migration from our local DB to cloud (GCP).
• Work across all stages of data Lifecycle
• Implement best practices across all data analytics processes
• Proactively monitor, identify, and escalate issues or root causes of systemic issues
• Enable data scientists, business and product partners to fully leverage our platform
• Data governance best practices

Impact You'll Make

Essential Skills & Experience:
• Extensive experience in Big Data technologies such as Hive, Spark and Hadoop.
• Big Data Technologies – SQL, Python, Oracle DB, PySpark, Pandas, Jupyter , Airflow, Talend, Jenkins
• Experience in Google Cloud Platform: dataproc, bigquery, cloud storage, dataflow
• Experience in Python programming language
• Experience in Oracle DB experience and cloud database migration
• R-studio experience is an advantage

What’s In It For you?

At TransUnion you will be joining a friendly, forward thinking global business.

We’re happy to talk flexible working. We operate a hybrid model allowing you to explore the balance of work and hours from home and/or from our Madrid.

TransUnion – a place to grow: 

If there’s something on the list of essential / desirable skills that you can’t quite tick off, don’t let that put you off applying. We are open to exploring training and development opportunities for the right candidate to ensure you are successful.

We know imposter syndrome is real, lets confront it so we can continue to grow and thrive together.

Interview & Hiring Process

Most of our recruitment processes are virtual, so you’ll get to know our hiring managers and teams over the phone and through video. If we need you to attend a physical in person interview your recruiter will inform of this.

Additional Support

At TransUnion, we’re committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all individual’s talents and perspectives are valued. When you apply for a position with us, you’re not just joining a team, you’re becoming part of a community that celebrates differences and embraces equality. We understand that everyone has different needs, which is why we offer a range of reasonable adjustments to our recruitment process. Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments to help you through the application process or to attend an interview with us by contacting ukrecruitment@transunion.com

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

TransUnion Job Title

Acquisition Exempt, Acquired Associate

Day To Day You’ll Be
• Passion for technology in the field of data engineering and analytics
• Design, build, test and deploy cutting edge big data solutions at scale
• Extract, clean, transform, and analyze vast amounts of raw data from various Data Sources
• Build data pipelines and API integrations with various internal systems
• Improving and maintaining our data ware house.
• Experience on data migration from our local DB to cloud (GCP).
• Work across all stages of data Lifecycle
• Implement best practices across all data analytics processes
• Proactively monitor, identify, and escalate issues or root causes of systemic issues
• Enable data scientists, business and product partners to fully leverage our platform
• Data governance best practices

Impact You'll Make

Essential Skills & Experience:
• Extensive experience in Big Data technologies such as Hive, Spark and Hadoop.
• Big Data Technologies – SQL, Python, Oracle DB, PySpark, Pandas, Jupyter , Airflow, Talend, Jenkins
• Experience in Google Cloud Platform: dataproc, bigquery, cloud storage, dataflow
• Experience in Python programming language
• Experience in Oracle DB experience and cloud database migration
• R-studio experience is an advantage

What’s In It For you?

At TransUnion you will be joining a friendly, forward thinking global business.

We’re happy to talk flexible working. We operate a hybrid model allowing you to explore the balance of work and hours from home and/or from our Madrid.

TransUnion – a place to grow: 

If there’s something on the list of essential / desirable skills that you can’t quite tick off, don’t let that put you off applying. We are open to exploring training and development opportunities for the right candidate to ensure you are successful.

We know imposter syndrome is real, lets confront it so we can continue to grow and thrive together.

Interview & Hiring Process

Most of our recruitment processes are virtual, so you’ll get to know our hiring managers and teams over the phone and through video. If we need you to attend a physical in person interview your recruiter will inform of this.

Additional Support

At TransUnion, we’re committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all individual’s talents and perspectives are valued. When you apply for a position with us, you’re not just joining a team, you’re becoming part of a community that celebrates differences and embraces equality. We understand that everyone has different needs, which is why we offer a range of reasonable adjustments to our recruitment process. Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments to help you through the application process or to attend an interview with us by contacting ukrecruitment@transunion.com

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

TransUnion Job Title

Acquisition Exempt, Acquired Associate

jobs_results.description:
¡En K-LAGAN te estamos esperando para continuar creciendo juntos!

Somos una empresa estratégica internacional de servicios tecnológicos, comprometida esencialmente con su equipo y con la sociedad. Ofrecemos soluciones en servicios IT, desarrollos de ingeniería, de electrónica, y proyectos de I+D. Nuestro compromiso es contratar a los mejores talentos independientemente de su raza, religión, sexo, edad y personas con otras capacidades, promoviendo su desarrollo profesional y personal.

Misión: Como Data Engineer formarás parte de un equipo de data transversal para IT al tanto de la estrategia de la compañía y participación en la misma, desarrollando pipelines y workflows para ingesta y transformación de los datos, diseñando probando e implementando modelos ETL e integraciones de datos. Aportaras tu visión analítica y tu background técnico, danto tus propias ideas, nuevos métodos o tecnologías con el objetivo de mejorar el stack tecnológico actual.

Buscamos un perfil de Datos con... experiencia en:
• Experiencia de al menos 1 año en entornos cloud, valorable Azure cloud con Data Factory/Databricks.
• Conocimiento y experiencia en lenguajes de programación Python y valorable Scala.
• Experiencia en entornos SQL (y de bases de datos relacionales)
• Experiencia o interés en entornos de DevOps con herramientas de CI/CD
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita, tanto en español como en inglés (parte del proceso de selección es en inglés)

Nuestro proceso de selección incluye:

-Primera entrevista

-Entrevista Técnica

-Entrevista Final

Además, en K-LAGAN, queremos que disfrutes de toda la experiencia completa de ser parte de nuestro equipo, por ello ofrecemos:

¡IMPRESCINDIBLE! Contrato indefinido y proyecto estable.

MODALIDAD: Híbrido: 80% homeoffice / 20% oficina en Barcelona centro

TEAM BUILDING: Barbacoas, cafés tecnológicos e igual este año se nos ocurren más cosas para estar más cerca de vosotros.

SEGUIMIENTO CONTINUO: contarás con nuestros fantásticos TBM para seguir creciendo y tener feedback sobre tu desempeño y día a día.

DEPARTAMENTO DE CARRERAS Y FORMACIÓN ¿Quieres dar el siguiente paso? ¡Te ayudamos!

EVENTOS ESPECIALES: Cena de verano, Cena de Navidad y Día Solidario.

DÍA CUMPLEAÑOS LIBRE: ¡disfrútalo cómo, dónde y con quién quieras!

AYUDAS en guarderías, KM e idiomas.

¿Crees que podría ser interesante para ti?

¡Escríbeme y lo comentamos

jobs_results.title: Data Engineer - AI
jobs_results.description:
THE PLACE TO BE

Empowered by our motto, "making data matter," Keyrus stands at the forefront of global consultancy in Data & Analytics, AI &Machine Learning, and Digital Transformation.

With a presence in 27 countries across 4 continents, we're on a mission to help our clients to improve their performance leveraging technological and functional expertise in data and analytics.

We are data experts, guiding our clients through their data journey regardless of their level of maturity in analytics. As an end-to-end partner, we address varied challenges that our clients face, from Advanced Analytics, Cloud, Data Governance, Visualisation to Enterprise Performance Management, from advisory to delivery.

With more than 3200 employees in all corners of the world, we help our clients on a global level with extensive knowledge, a start-up mindset, and a powerful international network.

Job Description

We are looking for a Data Engineer with at least 2 years of experience with AI, you will... be responsible for developing and implementing cutting-edge generative AI models to solve

complex problems and drive innovation across our organization.

Responsibilities
• Designing, developing, and implementing generative AI models and algorithms
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define AI project requirements and objectives, ensuring alignment with overall business goals.
• Conducting research to stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in generative AI, machine learning, and deep learning techniques and identify opportunities to integrate them into our products and services.

Requirements
• Fluent in English (B2+).
• Solid experience developing and implementing generative AI models, with a strong understanding of deep learning techniques such as GPT, VAE, and GANs.
• Computer Science, Statitstics or Mathematical Bachelors' Degree desirable.
• Experience with ETL and data integration processes.

CAREEER

The sky is the limit! We believe in people and the value they bring to our organization, that is why we are proud to have a company culture focused on people and for the people.

LEARNING AND DEVELOPMENT

In constant improvement! Our employees are the engine that makes Keyrus work every day, and those who make the difference in the projects we develop constantly receive training in the most cutting-edge technologies.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Good vibes only! We have a diverse, inclusive and pleasant environment. Teamwork, good environment, and company events we organize throughout the year to nurture and continually improve the company-employee relationship.

INNOVATION

We want to change the world! Innovation runs in our DNA, and we want our future co-workers to have that passion, commitment, enthusiasm and cooperative spirit that is part of our essence.

Social Benefits

Our strategy to change and improve our world begins through different social initiatives promoted by our Human Resources department such as flexible hours, family conciliation, and competitive remuneration packages at market level
